lesson: For AI/semiconductor companies, pull segment revenue breakdown (data center/gaming/auto) to properly assess customer and product concentration risk cited in filings
When citing profitability ratios (ROE, margins) as a bull-case strength, pull at least one peer's equivalent stats to support relative claims rather than asserting strength in isolation

Flag unverified news items (unconfirmed deals, anonymous critical commentary) with a visible confidence tag in the brief itself, not just in the underlying finding, so the reader can weight them appropriately
For high-beta/high-volatility names, supplement historical volatility with options-implied volatility or analyst estimate dispersion to strengthen the market-risk narrative
